**1 — Scene:** Four small pieces of ham-and-pineapple pizza, chopped cooked chicken, fruit chunks, cherry tomatoes and dark olives.

**2 — Vessel:** A large oval/rounded rectangular dinner plate, approximately 30 × 24 cm; equivalent circular diameter about **27 cm**. Estimated area: 3.14 × 13.5² = **572 cm²**. The plate at the left edge is excluded.

**3 — Items:** Pizza includes visible crust, tomato sauce, cheese, ham, pineapple and red onion. Alongside are chicken, pineapple chunks, a few orange melon-like pieces, cherry tomatoes and olives. No separate oil or dressing is clearly visible.

**4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy:** Pizza toppings are included in the pizza estimate, not counted again.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Density | Weight | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Ham-and-pineapple pizza | 40% | 229 × 1.5 = 344 ml | 0.9 | 310 g | 250 | 775 |
| Cooked chicken pieces | 26% | 149 × 1.6 = 238 ml | 0.95 | 226 g | 165 | 373 |
| Pineapple chunks | 9% | 51 × 2.0 = 102 ml | 0.6 | 61 g | 50 | 31 |
| Orange melon-like chunks | 2% | 11 × 1.5 = 17 ml | 0.6 | 10 g | 35 | 4 |
| Cherry tomatoes | 8% | 46 × 2.5 = 115 ml | 0.6 | 69 g | 18 | 12 |
| Dark olives | 3% | 17 × 2.0 = 34 ml | 0.7 | 24 g | 145 | 35 |

**Area check:** 40 + 26 + 9 + 2 + 8 + 3 = **88% covered**, consistent with the mostly full plate.

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **700 g and 1,230 kcal** is plausible for four substantial pizza pieces, a generous chicken pile and smaller produce portions. The main uncertainties are plate size and pizza thickness; overall uncertainty is roughly ±20–25%.
